about: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B architecture, 35B mixture of experts with 3B active, built-in MTP head) Q4_K_M from ornith-ai, whole model on the Radeon 890M iGPU's 48 GB UMA aperture via Vulkan, llama.cpp b12613, q8_0 KV, one slot at 131,072 tokens
setup: Windows 11 on a GMKtec EVO-X1 Pro (Ryzen AI 9 HX 470, Radeon 890M iGPU, 64 GB LPDDR5X-6400, 48 GB UMA aperture reported by the Vulkan driver). Unzip the llama.cpp Windows Vulkan build into the work directory as llama-b12613/, put the GGUF under models/ornith-ai-Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-GGUF-12393612/ and run the command from that work directory. No Docker, no WSL, no ROCm: the AMD Vulkan driver is the only stack involved.
